messages:
morgan: Heads up — I spotted a reproducible path where PII can get embedded then stored in our embeddings index during debug captures.
lee: Oh? can you repro locally?
sara: What kind of PII are we talking about? examples pls (no real data)
morgan: Sample flow — client sends user prompt with SSN, we run `embed(text)` then also persist the original request+embedding blob for 'debug replay'. If inspect toggles are on, payload saved unredacted.
vikram: Oof. We currently only scrub request body for full-text logs, not the embeddings store. The store is indexed for search + rerank.
lee: Is this mostly inspect/debug paths or normal production writes?
morgan: Mostly debug/canary writes triggered by `X-Debug-Inspect: true` header and when `console.inspect_enabled` is on. But a few internal rollouts enabled it for canary tenants.
sara: We should never keep raw text tied to an embedding unless it's masked. Two options: 1) strip PII before embedding; 2) store only hashed/synthetic provenance + embedding.
vikram: Stripping before embedding changes semantic space — could break fuzzy search. Hashing original text loses recoverability for replay. We need to balance debugability vs safety.
lee: Could we store a reversible encrypted payload keyed by tenant KMS and only allow decrypt for legal/audit flows?
morgan: That helps, but our current debug UX expects engineers to click 'view original' in console which should be fast. KMS decryption requires ACL/workflow.
sara: UX compromise: keep embeddings + a redacted preview for console. If someone needs original, require a gated request (audit ticket) that triggers KMS unwrap + audit log.
devex: @morgan can you paste the capture config snippet? makes it easier to propose a toggle.
morgan: Sure:
```json
{
  "capture": {
    "inspect_enabled": true,
    "persist_original": true, // dangerous
    "persist_embedding": true
  },
  "headers": {
    "X-Debug-Inspect": "true"
  }
}
```

lee: If we flip `persist_original` to false by default and add `redaction_level: "partial|none|full"` we can gate behavior.
vikram: Implementation notes: redaction needs to run before embedding. We can run a lightweight PII recognizer (SSN/email/creditcard) + mask. Doing that in the hot path might add ~5-20ms; measurable but acceptable for debug paths.
sara: Also we have embeddings telemetry quotas — storing full originals balloons storage and egress. So cost argument aligns with privacy.
morgan: Proposed immediate steps:
- Default `persist_original` -> false for all routes
- Run pre-embed redaction for any `persist_embedding` path
- Add console UX: 'Show redaction confidence' and 'Request unredacted (audit)' button
lee: I support. Add an internal flag for canary tenants so SRE can verify no regressions.
vikram: Backend work: add pre-embed hook + quick regex-based scrub fallback, keep ML PII model behind a feature flag. We'll add a sampling rule so only 0.1% of debug captures attempt to persist originals (for now).
morgan: Who wants to own the RFC? I'll start a short one and link to console mockups.
sara: I'll mock the console button flow and the audit ticket UX.
lee: I'll scope SRE canary + quota limits. We'll need a migration plan for existing blobs in the embeddings store (backfill redact?).
devex: Quick check: any compliance/reg teams to ping before we change default? @legal? (we don't have legal in this thread)
morgan: I'll ping compliance after RFC draft. Also created infra ticket <https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PLT-7890> for embedding backfill plan.
oncall-bot: Reminder: create runbook entry for debugging disabled original captures — ensures oncall knows the gated flow.
morgan: action items summarized: RFC (morgan), console mock (sara), SRE canary + quotas (lee), pre-embed hook + flag (vikram), compliance ping (morgan).
sara: +1 :thumbsup:
lee: +1
vikram: I'll open the PR for the regex scrub + hook, tag y'all.
morgan: Thanks everyone. Keeping this thread for updates, will post RFC link soon.
